source.body:
### Bug Description

## Bug Description

Two issues when using the **Anthropic Chat Model** node as the language model of an **AI Agent** node that has several tools (HTTP Request tools + structured tools).

### 1. Claude Sonnet 5.5 rejects every request (400)

With model `claude-sonnet-5-5`, every call fails:

```
400 invalid_request_error — thinking type "disabled" is not supported for this model, use "between_tools"
request_id: req_011CgQLZKZVVJVAu1TXnmK9p
```

The node sends `thinking: {"type": "disabled"}` even though "thinking" is not enabled in the node options. Per Anthropic's Sonnet 5.5 docs, `disabled` returns 400 on this model; the lowest setting is `{"type": "between_tools"}`, or the field can be omitted (adaptive).
`@langchain/anthropic` **1.5.1** already fixed this ("Stop sending `thinking: { type: "disabled" }` on ChatAnthropic requests when the user never configured thinking"). Bumping the dependency (and/or exposing `between_tools` in the node options) should fix it.

### 2. Parallel tool calls arrive at tools with missing required arguments

With `claude-sonnet-4-6` (thinking issue avoided), when the model emits **several tool_use blocks in one turn**, the agent fails with:

```
Received tool input did not match expected schema
✖ Required → at search_query
```
and on another tool:
```
✖ Required → at analyse   ✖ Required → at pertinence   ✖ Required → at resume
```

The same workflow, same prompt, same tools and **same model through an OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenRouter `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6`)** works reliably. This suggests the tool inputs of parallel `tool_use` blocks are lost/partially assembled in the Anthropic path (streamed `input_json_delta` consolidation?), not a model issue.

## To Reproduce

1. AI Agent node (v1.6), ≥3 tools with required string parameters (e.g. one HTTP Request tool with `search_query`, one tool with `analyse`, `pertinence`, `resume`).
2. Connect **Anthropic Chat Model** (v1.5), model `claude-sonnet-5-5` → error 1 on first call.
3. Switch model to `claude-sonnet-4-6`, prompt that encourages several searches → error 2 as soon as the model issues parallel tool calls (reproduced on 2 consecutive runs).
4. Replace the model with OpenRouter Chat Model, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6` → works.

## Expected behavior

- No `thinking` field sent unless configured (or `between_tools` available) so Sonnet 5.5 works.
- Every parallel `tool_use` block's full `input` is passed to the matching tool.

## Workaround

Use the same Claude model via OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible) instead of the native Anthropic node.

## Environment

- n8n version: [n8n version] — self-hosted (Docker, Coolify), queue mode: no
- Nodes: `@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.agent` v1.6, `@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.lmChatAnthropic` v1.5
- Models: `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-4-6` (Anthropic API, direct key)
- OS: Linux (Ubuntu VPS)

## Related

- Anthropic — What's new in Claude Sonnet 5.5 (breaking change: `between_tools`): https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5
- @langchain/anthropic CHANGELOG 1.5.1 / 1.3.11 (input_json_delta consolidation): https://app.unpkg.com/@langchain/anthropic@1.5.2/files/CHANGELOG.md
- Community threads with the same schema error: https://community.n8n.io/t/received-tool-input-did-not-match-expected-schema-required/276546 and https://community.n8n.io/t/problem-in-node-ai-agent-received-tool-input-did-not-match-expected-schema/86219


### To Reproduce

1. Create an AI Agent node (v1.6) with 3+ tools that have required string parameters (e.g. an HTTP Request tool with `search_query`, a tool with `analyse`, `pertinence`, `resume`).
2. Connect an Anthropic Chat Model node (v1.5) with model `claude-sonnet-5-5` (no thinking option enabled) and run the workflow.
   → Every call fails: `400 invalid_request_error – thinking type "disabled" is not supported for this model, use "between_tools"` (request_id req_011CgQLZKZVVJVAu1TXnmK9p).
3. Switch the model to `claude-sonnet-4-6` and use a prompt that leads the agent to call several tools in the same turn.
   → As soon as the model emits parallel tool_use blocks, the agent fails with:
   `Received tool input did not match expected schema ✖ Required → at search_query`
   and on another tool: `✖ Required → at analyse ✖ Required → at pertinence ✖ Required → at resume`
   (reproduced on 2 consecutive runs).
4. Replace the Anthropic Chat Model with the OpenRouter Chat Model using `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6` (same prompt, same tools) → works reliably.

### Expected behavior

- The Anthropic Chat Model node should not send `thinking: {type:"disabled"}` when thinking is not configured (already fixed upstream in @langchain/anthropic 1.5.1), or should offer `between_tools`, so that claude-sonnet-5-5 works (see https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/sonnet-5-5/whats-new-sonnet-5-5).
- When the model returns several tool_use blocks in one turn, each tool should receive its full `input` with all required arguments, as it does with the same model via an OpenAI-compatible provider.
